issues.title: The Roblox window freezes when you drag or resize it
issues.symptom: Dragging or resizing a Roblox window stops responding until you press the Windows key.
issues.workaround: Press the Windows key, then Escape.

rororoHelps.text: A lower frame-rate cap stops it for most people. Set this account's cap to 60.

issues.title: Roblox uses more and more memory the longer it runs
issues.symptom: Each Roblox client keeps growing, about 300 MB an hour even sitting idle. With several open, your PC runs out of memory after a day or so and Windows starts closing Roblox windows.
issues.workaround: Restart long-running clients about once a day.

rororoHelps.text: Keep the memory watchdog on. It warns you before a client runs your PC out of memory, and a Recycle button appears on that account's row: it restarts the client back into the same server.
